params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

# README review: Hoet-design/hoet-eyewear

Reviewed at commit bb408e3 (2026-09-10, merge of PR #52). Every change below is justified by a file in the clone.

## Stale, corrected

- "CI draait op elke push" -> CI runs on every pull request and on pushes to `main` only. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 3-6 (`on: push: branches: [main]` and `pull_request`).
- Quality report "via `ShaneDeconinck/hub-quality`" -> the action used is `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-quality@v1`. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 64.
- CI description now names PHP 8.5 and Node 22, PHPStan level 5, and the 14-day clover artifact. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 15, 27, 71-80; `phpstan.neon` line 5 (`level: 5`).

## Missing, added

- `/.well-known/build.json` (public build stamp, commit read from the checkout, 404 when there is no checkout). `app/Elixir/ElixirServiceProvider.php` lines 44-47; `app/Elixir/BuildStamp.php`.
- `/up` health endpoint. `bootstrap/app.php` line 16 (`health: '/up'`).
- `ELIXIR_TOKEN` named as the bearer token for `/api/elixir`. `config/elixir.php` line 11; `app/Elixir/ElixirController.php` lines 33-35; `.env.example` (name only).
- The four app-specific probes in `/api/elixir` (content mirror freshness, CSP report, order path, env check). `config/elixir.php` lines 23-40; `app/Elixir/MirrorFreshness.php`.
- Scheduled tasks `elixir:order-path` (daily 03:20) and `elixir:env-check` (weekly Monday 03:40), next to `elixir:beat`. `routes/console.php` lines 14-22; `app/Console/Commands/OrderPathCheck.php` line 45; `app/Console/Commands/EnvCheck.php` line 32.
- Webhook route and secret named: `POST /sanity/webhook`, `SANITY_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. `routes/web.php` line 33; `bootstrap/app.php` line 24; `.env.example` (name only).
- How tests run: sqlite in memory, no Sanity, Vite build required before the suite. `phpunit.xml` lines 26-27; `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 32-39 and 49-50.
- `php artisan mail:test <adres>`. `app/Console/Commands/MailTest.php` line 15.
- New section "Omgevingen": `elixir.json` declares only `production: https://hoet.be`, no staging. `elixir.json`.
- `elixir-fix.yml` (workflow_dispatch only, reusable workflow from `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-fix`, `permissions: contents: write`). `.github/workflows/elixir-fix.yml` lines 13-30, 33-34.
- `evidence.yml` (pull requests from `elixir/` branches, `abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action@v1`). `.github/workflows/evidence.yml` lines 10-18.

## Checked and still true

- Laravel 13, PHP 8.5, Blade, Vite: `composer.json` (`laravel/framework ^13.31.0`), `ci.yml` line 15, `package.json`, `vite.config.js`. Note `composer.json` requires only `php ^8.3`; CI and Forge run 8.5.
- Four locales with nl as base: `config/sanity.php` lines 17-18; `lang/{nl,en,fr,de}.json`.
- `SANITY_BRAND` values `brand-hoet` / `brand-cabrio`: `config/sanity.php` line 14; `.env.example` comment.
- `php artisan sanity:sync`: `app/Console/Commands/SanitySync.php` line 19.
- `elixir:beat` every minute: `routes/console.php` line 14; `app/Elixir/BeatCommand.php` line 24.
- `composer setup`, `composer dev`, `composer test`: `composer.json` scripts.
- `MAIL_ALWAYS_TO` behaviour: `.env.example` comment block.
- The three docs files exist: `docs/dns-cutover.md`, `docs/dns-target-zones.md`, `docs/mail-resend.md`.
- Dealer portal under `/bestellen` with admin role and user management: `routes/web.php` (`bestellen.*`, `DealerUserController`).

## Left as is, could not verify from the repo

- "Elixir meet dit project dagelijks van buitenaf en wekelijks van binnenuit": the cadence lives in Elixir, not in this repo. Not changed, not confirmed.
- "Commentaar in het Nederlands": `app/Elixir/BuildStamp.php`, `app/Elixir/MirrorFreshness.php` and `evidence.yml` carry English comments. This is a convention statement, not a fact claim, so it stays.
- The two em dashes in the "Documentatie" list are original text and were not restyled.

## Surprises

- `.env.example` lists the `NIGHTWATCH_ENABLED`, `NIGHTWATCH_TOKEN`, `NIGHTWATCH_INGEST_URI` block twice (once with the port comment, once under "Nightwatch (optioneel)"). Not a README matter, but `elixir:env-check` compares names against this file.
- `composer.json` still carries the skeleton `name: laravel/laravel` and description.
- `laravel/pint`, `larastan/larastan`, `phpunit/phpunit`, `mockery/mockery` sit in `require`, not `require-dev`.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
